CHAPTER.CAPTION: A Song of Ascents of David.
CHAPTER.VERS: Jehovah, my heart is not haughty, nor my eyes lofty. Neither have I walked in great matters, nor in things beyond my understanding.
Surely my soul has been calm and quiet, like a child weaned by his mother; my soul is like a weaned child.
O Israel, hope in Jehovah from this time and forever.
